props.label: Quantity to Split
props.description: Quantity to be removed from source & added to a new Serial

props.label: Split All
props.description:
If True - then Merge the full quantity from source, into the destination inventory
This will retire the source inventory record (inactive, qty=0) and create a new inventory record which will receive the full qty. All other attributes of the source inventory are inherited to the new inventory.
If True - ALL will be removed regardless of the value in Quantity to Split.

props.label: Print Label

*Gateway must be configured
